_comment: Per-host fetch profiles. Hosts are matched case-insensitively against the recipe start_url hostname.

portstewartparish.ie.notes: mDocs PDF table — use HTTP if HTTPS cert fails. Click Download on row 1; never print_to_pdf.

www.portstewartparish.ie.notes: mDocs PDF table — use HTTP if HTTPS cert fails.

portstewartparish.website.notes: Use HTTP — HTTPS cert expired. mdocs bulletin table can take 3–5 min to appear; PDF is row 1 Download link.

threepatrons.org.notes: Joomla Dropfiles — cloud ↓ icon (a.mod_downloadlink) serves Word .docx. Click the cloud on this Sunday's row — harvester converts docx → PDF automatically. Do not record diocese GDPR/Privacy PDFs — only mod_downloadlink on the parish host.

derriaghycatholicparish.com.notes: One.com WordPress — TLS ~0.6s but domcontentloaded often exceeds 60s; harvest uses commit navigation. Plan ~2–3 min per run.

www.derriaghycatholicparish.com.notes: One.com WordPress — TLS ~0.6s but domcontentloaded often exceeds 60s; harvest uses commit navigation. Plan ~2–3 min per run.

stmarysportglenone.org.notes: Joomla Dropfiles — click a.mod_downloadlink; harvest converts .docx to PDF.

clonmanyparish.ie.notes: Permanent /parish-bulletin/ URL — PDF filename changes weekly under /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/. PDF is in object.wp-block-file__embed[data] — harvest scrapes the embed URL. Use url_pattern *bulletin*.pdf — never pin a dated filename.

parishofclaudy.com.notes: Many docs.google.com/viewer iframes load slowly (2–4 min) — ignore previews. Bulletin is a Word file at onewebmedia/NEWSLETTER D-M-YY.docx — download directly.
